notes.title: Public Test Branch
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622440/81e4f2fef668b3ede723b4af42805505e69c7108.png"][/img]I’ve put some work into squashing bugs and adding a few QoL changes:[/p][list][*][p][b]“Daily Puzzle”[/b] is now generated locally (deterministic, Perth time). No internet required.[/p][/*][*][p]A spinner shows during generation and stays until play starts.[/p][/*][*][p]Full-screen toggle fixed; window size/position can now be locked in [i]Settings[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Notifications updated: [i]“Daily Puzzle ready”[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Card consistency: same critter/title in selection and gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click context menu on puzzles:[/p][list][*][p]Delete Random and PotD puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]Export puzzles[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]You can find the PTB under [i]Betas[/i] — the password is [b]“cutecritters.”[/b][/p][p]Please test and let me know if there are any issues.[/p][p]— Peter[/p]
